Numerical signal from the recorded benchmark
200,000 production paths • 10 replications per method / payoff / Greek • Windows 11, JAX 0.11.2 • exploratory, not universal guarantees

text.tspan: adaptive/ selector, uncertainty criteria, admissibility rules
estimators/ pathwise, LRM, FD-CRN and digital estimators
references/ Black–Scholes and cash-digital analytic values
tests/ estimator, validity, reference and CLI tests
results/ CSV estimates, summaries, environment record
• The admissibility table is analyst-specified; it is not a formal proof system.
• Bootstrap U90 describes pilot-score uncertainty, not estimator unbiasedness.
• The pilot score is variance × measured seconds per path; selection can cost time.
• Only terminal GBM with call, put and cash-digital call is currently validated.
• Ten-replication results are exploratory and hardware/JAX-version dependent.
• Do not interpret the benchmark as evidence that adaptive selection always wins.

svg.text: Reproducible inputs • explicit validity rules • honest timing • analytical reference checks
